shortlist.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) and atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement

shortlist.label: POEMS syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute progression of symptoms, severe flaccid quadriparesis, and reduced muscle stretch reflexes

shortlist.label: Plasma cell leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow and high white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cranial nerve involvement and presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive symptoms and presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid and high white blood cell count

shortlist.label: Multiple myeloma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow and high white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid

raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis), atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid, and diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in the bone marrow are highly suggestive of leukemia, with Acute myeloid leukemia being a common type that can present with these features.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: While it can cause neurological symptoms, the presence of leukemia cutis and atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid is more indicative of leukemia.

rejected.label: POEMS syndrome
rejected.why: POEMS syndrome typically presents with a combination of polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, monoclonal gammopathy, and skin changes, but the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid is not typical.

rejected.label: Plasma cell leukemia
rejected.why: It is a type of leukemia, but the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid and the clinical presentation are more suggestive of Acute myeloid leukemia.

rejected.label: Intravascular lymphoma
rejected.why: It is a rare type of lymphoma that can present with neurological symptoms, but the presence of leukemia cutis and atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid is more indicative of leukemia.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: It is a rare type of lymphoma that can present with skin lesions, but the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid and the clinical presentation are more suggestive of leukemia.

rejected.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
rejected.why: While it can present with similar symptoms, the presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) is more commonly associated with Acute myeloid leukemia.

rejected.label: Multiple myeloma
rejected.why: It is a type of plasma cell disorder that can present with bone marrow abnormalities, but the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid and the clinical presentation are more suggestive of leukemia.
